name: Pull Lucky Blocks
desc:
Pull Lucky Blocks! 
💪 Lift heavy dumbells to get Stronger and to grow Bigger 💪

💡 How to Play:
- Lift heavy weights to get Strong!  💪
- Pull Lucky Blocks back to your Base! 🏃‍♂️
- Don't get caught by the Guards! 👮
- Open your Lucky Blocks to start earning Money! 🏠
- Upgrade your Dumbells to pull Heavier Lucky Blocks! ⚡

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash and a Brainrot! 👍
